==Biography==
A unidentified [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] captured [[Dova Brigger]], who had a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on her and her [[Kal Brigger|brother]], by the leader of the [[Smugglers' Confederation]] [[Nirama]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified bounty hunter was first mention in [[James Luceno]]'s novel [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']], which was released on [[October 21]], [[2008]].
